domain.text: Shared development methodology tooling: write-journal lock handling.

impressions.text: The delivery addressed momentary write-journal lock contention that could leave a successful GitHub write without its board follow-up.
The reviewer reported retries at 100 ms intervals, reclamation of locks older than 3 seconds when their process is gone, and tests covering brief contention, dead holders, and live locks.
The supplied thread supports these implementation and review details, but does not explicitly assess model strengths or weaknesses.
